issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 05 returns the column 'avg_flaeche' as the same value as 'kreis' (a text column) instead of a numeric aggregation of the area. The problem statement asks for the average area per Landkreis, but solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql selects 'kreis as avg_flaeche', producing a non-numeric/incorrect result and contradicting the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution, compute the average of the 'flaeche' column rather than aliasing the 'kreis' column. For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) as avg_flaeche FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis; This produces a numeric average area per Landkreis as requested.
